column1: # harness-dial-cases.tsv — the ONE precedence contract for every control-plane
# dial, asserted independently by the bash lib, the Clojure report, and the TS
# SDK. Three readers of one state file diverge unless something holds them to
# the same table; this is that something.
# The algebra only. Which registry a key belongs to, and which categories are
# excluded from `all`, are per-axis facts tested separately.
# resolve(all, cat, item, env, now) -> on|off
#   precedence: item > category > all > default(on); env beats state entirely.
#   an `off:until=<iso>` whose deadline has passed reads as `on` AT ITS OWN
#   LEVEL and stops the search — a lapsed TTL restores the guard, it does not
# columns: id, all, cat, item, env, now, expect
#   all/cat/item  a raw state value, or `-` when that level is unset
#   now           ISO instant for until= evaluation, or `-` when irrelevant
